title: Hand-painted animation: a bird meets a butterfly
summary: A 5-second silent, hand-painted character story in a sunny garden. Landscape 16:9.
prompt: Create a 5-second silent hand-painted animation of an original rounded teal bird meeting a pink butterfly in a sunny garden. Begin with an iris opening, let the bird notice the butterfly, react with a happy bounce, then hold the affectionate reaction before the iris closes. Use the claude-animation template and local claude-animation-p5 renderer. Landscape 16:9, 1920×1080, 24 fps. Prefer flat colour washes and boiling ink outlines; no watercolour fills, lettering, audio, or external scripts. Deliver a playable MP4 through the Open Design media dispatcher.
